overview_description.description:
Yasmina is the first embedded insurance platform in Saudi Arabia, empowering digital businesses to offer instant, personalized insurance directly at checkout. With a plug-and-play API, Yasmina enables platforms in sectors such as automotive, real estate, HR tech, and e-commerce to boost revenue by offering relevant insurance products with minimal friction and operational burden.

Built with full regulatory approval and a proprietary full-stack infrastructure, Yasmina connects with top insurers such as Tawuniya, Medgulf, Walaa, Rajhi Takaful, and Wataniya, giving partners access to a wide range of insurance solutions—from car and home coverage to health and SME medical insurance—all through a seamless integration process.

Why Yasmina?
- Embedded Insurance Made Easy: Businesses can offer protection to their customers with a single line of code.
- Revenue Growth: Partners earn system fees on every policy sold, without handling claims, providing support, or managing regulations.
- Fast Integration: Go live in under 24 hours with pre-approved insurance flows and comprehensive end-to-end API documentation.
- Regulator-Approved: Approved and compliant, enabling secure operations at scale across the GCC.

Trusted by Digital Leaders
Yasmina powers insurance sales for top platforms in Saudi Arabia and the region, covering over 3 million users and issuing more than 400,000 policies to date. The platform is backed by leading VCs including Scene Holding, Access Bridge Ventures, Sanabil 500, and Arzan VC.
